inlines.v: MOOT, verb transitive [Latin contra.] To debate; to discuss; to argue for and against. The word is applied chiefly to the disputes of students in law, who state a question and discuss it by way of exercise to qualify themselves for arguing causes in court. MOOT, verb intransitive To argue or plead on a supposed cause. MOOT
